label: prf:tmli-constituent-composite-agreement
title: Proof that constituent and composite traces agree
html:
Under the hypothesis, \beta_{\mathfrak{H}} is (up to cyclic rotation) a product w_0 w_1 \cdots w_{N-2} with w_i a word in \sigma_i^{\pm 1}, and the letters grouped at generator \sigma_i are exactly w_i, with Hecke reduction \rho(w_i) = a_i\sigma_i + b_i. The Markov trace product then gives \mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta_{\mathfrak{H}})) = \prod_i (z\,a_i + b_i) = \prod_i \hat{V}_i^{\mathrm{const}}, and cyclicity of \mathrm{tr}_M covers the rotations.

For the counterexample, \sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0\sigma_1 = h\,\sigma_0\sigma_1\sigma_0 + \sigma_1\sigma_0 by the braid and Hecke relations, so its trace is h(hz^2 + z) + z^2, while the grouped product is (hz + 1)^2; these differ by z^2 - hz - 1 = -(q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1)^2. \square
